data.body: Investigation COMPLETE (BASIC, dso:investigator-basic, 4 confirmed dynamic tests). ROOT_CAUSE: predicate _branch_is_staged_promotion (merge-to-main-pr.sh:127) uses [[ "${1:-${BRANCH:-}}" == staged-* ]]; Bash ${1:-default} collapses an explicit empty-string arg to the fallback, so T17's _branch_is_staged_promotion "" (test-merge-to-main-resume-inc008.sh:122) reads ambient $BRANCH. T17 lacks BRANCH isolation (T18/T19 save/restore BRANCH; T17 does not). Production fallback-to-$BRANCH on no-arg is intentional (T18/T19). FIX (test-only, UPDATE): line 122 -> 'if ! BRANCH= _branch_is_staged_promotion ""; then'. Hypothesis Validation Gate: PASS.
